name: Duloxetine
mechanism: Inhibits serotonin and norepinephrine reuptake, modulates pain pathways
dosing: Depression: 60mg OD. Neuropathic pain: start 30mg OD, increase to 60mg. Max 120mg daily
contraindications: Uncontrolled hypertension, severe renal/hepatic impairment, MAOIs (within 14 days)
monitoring: Blood pressure, mood, bleeding risk, hepatic function
pregnancy: Avoid if possible - use only if benefit outweighs risk
sideEffects: Nausea, dry mouth, dizziness, fatigue, sweating, hypertension
pharmacokinetics: Hepatic metabolism via CYP1A2 and CYP2D6, half-life 12h
clinicalPearls: Useful for diabetic neuropathy and fibromyalgia. Monitor BP - can cause hypertension. Withdraw gradually
indication: Depression, generalised anxiety disorder, diabetic neuropathy, fibromyalgia, stress urinary incontinence
